description: Published libraries. Ranges only widen, engines is never touched, and @types/node stays on the engines minimum. Extend after default.

packageRules.description: Renovate's default range strategy for dev dependencies too, overriding default's bump: peerDependencies and other ranges only widen, so consumers choose their own versions.
engines is a promise to consumers. It only changes by hand, when the library drops a Node version.
@types/node follows the oldest supported Node (the engines minimum), not .nvmrc, so its majors are raised by hand with engines.
